title: Resolve ambiguity between .moeb/skills/ directory and config.toml skill configuration
description: The .moeb/skills/ directory exists but contains only a README. It is unclear whether skill overrides should live here or be declared in config.toml, and moeb init does not copy skill templates into .moeb/skills/. The moeb.ai-first-artifact-refinement spec placed skill.template.md in src/moeb/internal/skills/ (dev context) rather than .moeb/skills/, deferring this decision. The Skills folder and config.toml may currently be doubling up on the same responsibility.
proposed_resolution: Define and enforce the convention: .moeb/skills/ is for project-level skill overrides — a same-named file here overrides the bundled default in assets/skills/. config.toml references skills by name only and does not duplicate file content. Update moeb init to offer copying bundled skill templates into .moeb/skills/ when a project override is desired. Implement moeb skill list to enumerate bundled and override skills with their source (bundled | project-override). Remove any config.toml fields that duplicate skill file content.
